_prov.method: 11 searches: one per AD-50 neighborhood, one for Emily Gallagher, and six that pair the neighborhoods with a subject (housing, schools, transit, health, business, local government). Of 192 results from the last 180 days, 95 from 37 sources that are not news organizations (apps such as Citizen, government and corporate press offices, listings sites) or not on the outlet list were set aside, and 14 repeat listings of the same headline were removed (News 12 posts one story to each of its regional sites). The remaining 83 articles were grouped into 83 stories: headlines published within 3 days of each other that share most of their distinctive words count as one story, shown under the earliest report with the other outlets linked beside it.
_prov.caveats: Google News is relevance-ranked and caps each search near 100 results, so this is a broad sample, not a census of local coverage. A neighborhood name-match does not guarantee the story is inside AD-50. Story grouping and topic tags are automated word-matching and will sometimes be wrong. The outlet list is a judgment call; a legitimate outlet missing from it is dropped until added.
